Description.description: A single case imported from Intelligent Office and carried through Tax and AQS review. Header fields are captured at intake (BR-001); the stable business key is the IO reference. User-owned so allocation can address a team or a named individual (BR-003).
Date the advice was given.
Target date for the case to be completed. Set and amended by a manager as an administrative update; changes are audited (BR-012).
Work priority for the case, set by a manager.
Work priority for the case: Low, Normal, High or Urgent. Set by a manager as an administrative update; changes are audited (BR-012).
Adviser identifier code carried from Intelligent Office.
Name of the adviser responsible for the advice under review.
Supervisory status of the adviser at the time of the case.
Supervisory status of the adviser: PreCAS, CAS, Enhanced or Watchlist.
Intelligent Office reference for the case. The BR-001 import key and the alternate key, so re-running an import upserts rather than duplicates under NFR-REL-01 (AD-014).
The canonical case lifecycle plus the No Check Required bypass state for cases that must not be graded (AD-036). Tax wrong-route is a manager-controlled reassignment, not a status.

Position of the case in the canonical lifecycle, from Imported to Closed, plus the No Check Required bypass state. Privileged transitions run as server-side commands, not client updates (AD-003, AD-036).
The advice event type of the case.
Advice event type: New advice, Ongoing, Review or Switch/Transfer.
Date the check was performed.
Name of the checker who performed or is performing the review.
Client name or initials for the case. Personal data retained indefinitely; erasure is by anonymisation in place, never deletion (AD-037).
Short label identifying the case in lists and worklists.
Unique identifier for the outcome case.
Name of the paraplanner who supported the case. Para-planners are notified without operational access by default (BR-009).
Paraplanner identifier code carried from Intelligent Office.
Whether the check happens before or after the advice is issued.
Whether this is a pre-issue or post-issue check.

Links a case to the case it replaces. The reverse navigation is the replacement case. NoCascade delete is deliberate: removing one case must never delete the case it replaced or was replaced by, so history survives.
The product or products recommended in the case.
The product or solution type. Drives system-derived CRP applicability (AD-021).
Product or solution type: Accumulation investment, Accumulation Pension, IHT, Protection or No change reviews. The system derives CRP applicability from this (AD-021).

The review route the case follows: Tax-only, AQS-only or Tax-then-AQS (BR-004). Restrict delete stops a route that cases depend on being removed. Optional at intake because the route is derived once the Tax-check requirement is known.
Why the case was selected for checking.
Selection basis: Random, Mandatory, High Risk or Thematic.
Whether the case needs the Tax check section. Drives the BR-004 route.
Whether the Tax check section applies. Drives the BR-004 route (Tax-only, AQS-only or Tax-then-AQS).
What the Tax team decided after its check.
Tax team disposition after its check: Submit to AQS or Return to paraplanner.
Whether the client shows vulnerability indicators.
Vulnerability status: Yes, No, Potentially vulnerable or N/A.
Unique identifier of the user who created the record.
Date and time when the record was created.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.
Sequence number of the import that created this record.
Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.
Date and time when the record was modified.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.
Date and time that the record was migrated.

Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.
